prompt: Build a landing page for a dog walking business called Happy Paws
summary: A marketing landing page for Happy Paws, a neighborhood dog walking business. The goal is to convert visitors into booked walks/meet-and-greets, so the site is content-driven: services, pricing, service area, walker bios, testimonials, and a clear call-to-action. No user accounts, bookings storage, or dynamic data are needed for a launch landing page, so a single static site is the smallest primitive that fully serves the prompt — no web_service, postgres, or key_value is justified since nothing needs to run server-side logic or persist data beyond the page content itself.

services.name: happy-paws-landing
services.buildCommand: echo 'Static site — no build step required'
